plan.estimand: Main effect of 2-level factor in 3-by-2 balanced factorial ANOVA with independent normal observations and common variance; cell means unstructured; test has 1 numerator degree of freedom
plan.hypothesis: H₀: marginal means of 2-level factor are equal (null hypothesis); H₁: not equal (two-sided alternative)
assumptions: Observations are independent across cells and within cells
Responses are normally distributed within each cell
Homogeneity of variance (common within-cell variance σ²)
Cell means are unstructured (full 6-cell model fitted)
Design is balanced with equal participants per cell
Type I error rate α = 0.05
Two-sided test of main effect (numerator df = 1)
missing_information: Specification of which factor (3-level or 2-level) the main effect test targets—user states 'the 2-level factor main effect' but clarification on the factorization and test structure may refine the error term and noncentrality specification
clarification_questions: Is the 2-level factor the second factor in the design (rows × columns notation), or does the labeling reflect a different convention?
Is the error term the residual after fitting all 6 cell means (i.e., error df = N − 6), or is it structured as a pooled within-cell term?

Should the partial η² = 0.06 be interpreted as the proportion of variance explained by the 2-level factor main effect in the full model context, after accounting for the 3-level factor and interaction?
scientific_notes: The noncentrality parameter λ for the F-test is derived from the relationship between partial η² and the F statistic: f = √(η²_p / (1 − η²_p)). With η²_p = 0.06, this yields f ≈ 0.2476 (Cohen's f effect size).

Power calculation uses noncentral F distribution with numerator df = 1, denominator df = N − 6 (residual df in the 3×2 balanced design with n participants per cell), and noncentrality λ = f² × N = (η²_p / (1 − η²_p)) × N.
Sample size will be inverted via numerical root-finding to achieve target power = 0.80 at α = 0.05.
Result will be returned as minimum integer participants per cell under the stated rounding convention (smallest admissible n such that power ≥ 0.80).
